text: Done: per-parlay collateral cap $45 -> $75 (open total $90 -> $150 so one parlay can't use it all; stake $12, margin and $20 loss stop unchanged). On the 8% question, the honest breakdown of ~23k requests: 54% have a leg we have no fair for (the fix for that just shipped and is restarting), 15% are 6+ legs, 13% are two-leg-same-game combos that aren't 'side + total' (e.g. 3-leg same-game), 8% hit the stake cap (the $75 change), the rest props over our 2-prop limit. I'll re-measure once the new scan has run and tell you which class is biggest.
